sections.heading: Understanding Curtain Wall Systems and Why Repairs Matter
sections.body: Curtain wall systems are the non-structural outer skin of a building, typically composed of glass panels, aluminum framing, and specialized sealants or gaskets. Unlike traditional windows, these systems span entire building facades and play a critical role in weather resistance, thermal performance, and the overall appearance of a commercial structure. When individual glass panels crack, seals fail, or framing members corrode or warp, the consequences can range from water infiltration and interior damage to compromised structural integrity of the facade itself. In Arlington, where commercial buildings must contend with humid summers, freezing winters, and the occasional severe storm, timely curtain wall repairs are not optional — they are a key part of responsible building management. Addressing issues early prevents minor seal failures from becoming costly water damage claims and helps maintain the professional appearance that tenants and visitors expect from a well-maintained commercial property.

sections.heading: Common Curtain Wall Problems We Repair in Arlington
sections.body: Our team regularly addresses a wide range of curtain wall issues for Arlington property owners and managers. Cracked or shattered glass panels are among the most urgent repairs, as they create immediate safety hazards and expose the building interior to the elements. Failed or deteriorating perimeter sealants allow moisture to penetrate behind the glass, leading to interior water damage, mold growth, and insulation degradation over time. Gasket failures between panel sections are another frequent culprit, particularly in older curtain wall installations that have seen years of thermal expansion and contraction cycles. We also handle aluminum frame repairs and replacements, including sections that have suffered impact damage, corrosion, or structural deformation. For buildings near Pentagon City and the broader Arlington Boulevard corridor, where foot traffic and urban activity are high, facade damage from impacts or vandalism is also not uncommon. Whatever the root cause, we diagnose the problem accurately and recommend the most effective and durable repair approach.

sections.heading: Our Commercial Curtain Wall Repair Process
sections.body: Every curtain wall repair project begins with a thorough assessment of the affected facade sections. Our experienced glaziers inspect not only the visible damage but also the surrounding framing, drainage channels, and sealant lines to identify any secondary issues that could cause problems down the road. Once we have a clear picture of the scope of work, we develop a repair plan that minimizes disruption to your building's tenants and daily operations. Depending on access requirements, we use a combination of lift equipment, swing stages, and interior access to reach all areas safely. Glass panels are measured, ordered, and installed to match the existing system specifications as closely as possible, ensuring visual consistency across the facade. Sealants and gaskets are applied using commercial-grade materials appropriate for the specific curtain wall system in use. We work efficiently to restore your building envelope to its full function and appearance.

faq.q: How do I know if my curtain wall needs repair or full replacement?
faq.a: In many cases, individual damaged panels, failed sealants, or localized frame issues can be repaired without replacing the entire curtain wall system. Our glaziers assess each situation individually and recommend the most cost-effective solution based on the extent and nature of the damage. Full replacement is typically only necessary when the structural framing itself is extensively compromised or when the system is at the end of its useful service life.

faq.q: How long does a typical curtain wall repair take in Arlington?
faq.a: Repair timelines depend on the scope of the damage, the number of panels involved, glass lead times, and site access requirements. Single-panel replacements or targeted sealant work can often be completed in one to two days, while larger multi-section repairs may take longer. We provide a timeline estimate before work begins so you can plan accordingly.

faq.q: Can you match the existing glass appearance on my building?
faq.a: We work to match existing glass specifications as closely as possible, including tint, reflectivity, and thickness. While an exact optical match is not always guaranteed depending on the age of the original installation and product availability, our team sources materials carefully and will discuss any visible differences with you before proceeding.

faq.q: Do you handle emergency curtain wall repairs after storm or impact damage?
faq.a: Yes. We understand that damaged curtain wall panels can create urgent safety and weather-exposure concerns for building occupants and owners. We offer responsive service for emergency situations and will work to assess and temporarily secure or permanently repair storm or impact-damaged sections as quickly as possible.
